title: Send and receive failures
description: Messages ThinkZap could not send to the contact or process when received. Each failure's detail shows the error of every attempt.
retentionNotice: Failures are kept for {{days}} days. After that they are deleted and can no longer be reprocessed.

attempts.title: Failed attempts
attempts.empty: No attempts recorded: the failure predates the log or is past the retention period.

inbound.description: Received messages and events that ran out of processing attempts. Reprocessing puts the event back on the inbound queue.
inbound.notReprocessableHint: Redelivering this kind of event could duplicate a message or repeat an action on the customer's side.
inbound.confirmDescription: The event goes back to the inbound queue and is processed again under the normal rules. Check the date: an old event may arrive out of the conversation's context.

result.requeued: Event returned to the inbound queue.
result.not-found: Failure not found or past the retention period.
result.schedule-failed: Could not schedule the reprocessing. Try again.

inbound.detailNotFound: Failure not found. It may be past the retention period and deleted.
inbound.emptyTitle: No receive failures in the period
inbound.emptyDescription: There are no failed received events for the chosen filters.
inbound.errorDescription: Check your connection and try again.

client.title: Message failures
client.description: This customer's sending and receiving over the last {{days}} days.
client.empty: No failures in the last {{days}} days.
client.openAll: See all of this customer's failures
client.unavailableDescription: Could not load this customer's failures.
